sources.snippet: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model from Alibaba Cloud’s Qwen3.6 family. It features 35 billion total parameters with only 3 billion active during inference, delivering strong performance with excellent efficiency on edge devices.
